title: incomplete Eq derives: Session/AccountInfo/BlobUploadResponse
description: Round 6 changelog says 'Added PartialEq/Eq derives to all major types' but Session, AccountInfo, and BlobUploadResponse are missing Eq/PartialEq. A user reading the changelog will expect Session: Eq and be surprised when they can't use it as a HashMap key or in assert_eq! without the PartialEq-only footgun. Session and AccountInfo can trivially derive Eq (all their fields — String, bool, HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> — implement Eq). BlobUploadResponse can derive PartialEq + Eq (String, u64, Id, Option<String>). The maintenance consequence: this is a semver cliff — once callers depend on the absence of Eq, adding it is a non-breaking change, but the window to add it cleanly is now, before 1.0.
